Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: GAME-READY TRANSPARENT SPRITE PART ATLAS. Using the reference spider only as appearance/material reference, create a new square PNG with a real transparent alpha background and EXACTLY a uniform 4 by 4 grid of SIXTEEN isolated sprite parts, one part fully contained in each equal cell with 15 percent empty margin, no borders, no labels, no text, no ground shadows. Each row left to right, then next row:
row1: [0] large furry abdomen top view, [1] cephalothorax top view, [2] coxa segment, [3] trochanter segment.
row2: [4] femur segment, [5] patella segment, [6] tibia segment, [7] metatarsus segment.
row3: [8] tarsus with small paired claws, [9] narrow pedicel connector, [10] left pedipalp, [11] right pedipalp.
row4: [12] left chelicera with fang, [13] right chelicera with fang, [14] one short brown chitin connecting segment, [15] tiny matching tarsal pad.
All leg segments are oriented horizontally, proximal connection end at LEFT and distal end at RIGHT. Each must be one continuous intact piece between the real joints, detached and not touching any other piece. The abdomen and cephalothorax point forward/up. Natural dark brown chitin and short tan hairs, crisp edge transparency with all hairs preserved, realistically rendered but lit softly as game sprites, same scale-independent material style as the reference. These parts will be reused eight times to bind independent spider legs and export animation frames. NO complete spider, no anatomy poster, no diagram background, no mechanical spheres or empty socket holes. Real usable sprite parts only.
